# Business Process Pattern Audit

Evercraft public capability ID: buildflow-process-audit-machine-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: human_auth_handoff
Public handoff: https://base44.app/api/apps/6ab26dc00debf9a25bca5f3e/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs

## Use this when

- map how our process actually works
- find bottlenecks in this business workflow
- analyze our purchase approval process
- reconstruct our process from logs
- where are exceptions slowing us down
- audit our procure to pay workflow
- compare the real workflow to company policy
- process mining from operational history

## Problem

A business has fragmented operational events and wants to discover the real recurring workflow, cycle time and exception points without replacing its current systems first.

## Inputs

Tenant-scoped process observations/events and optional process/source-system scope.

## Outputs

Candidate step sequence, sample size, median duration, exception rate, confidence, evidence refs and review state. No policy change or external action.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
- Human UI required: yes
- Confirmation: Pattern discovery may analyze authorized data. Observed behavior is never silently promoted to configured policy.
- Payment authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, or payment state.
